summary: Iteration 18 — Trip Map feature (backend GET /api/trips/{trip_id}/route-geometry + route_cache, frontend TripMap.jsx). Backend: 14/14 pytest tests pass (auth 401/404/200 for owner+editor+viewer, payload shape, 0/1/2 stops, car ORS live geojson (LineString 1849-3117 pts), plane haversine-only with zero route_cache entries, other all-null, route_cache write + cache-hit, regression on 12 existing endpoints + openapi). Frontend: full Playwright e2e on seeded trip TEST_MAP_UI (Roma/car → Firenze/train → London/plane → Napoli/other): wrapper above timeline, default-open, localStorage persistence across reload, legend chips, numbered pins, marker popup + Go-to-stop scroll, polyline popups for train/plane/other, Nunito on Dashboard+Trip h1, Landing/Dashboard regression OK. One UX defect found: marker click auto-scrolls page so its own popup goes off-screen.

minor.issue: ORS geometry is returned unsimplified (1849-3117 coordinate pairs per segment; 41KB for a 4-stop trip, would be several hundred KB for 10+ stops). Consider ORS geometry_simplify=true or server-side douglas-peucker before caching.

No per-request cap on ORS fan-out: a trip with N stops fires N-1 concurrent ORS calls on a cold cache — with the free-tier 40 req/min key this will 429 on large trips (degrades gracefully to dashed lines, but silently). Consider sequential/semaphore-limited fetching.
Cache is keyed only on coords+mode with no version/provider field, so a future ORS profile/format change cannot be invalidated without dropping the collection.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking a numbered pin fires BOTH the popup and scrollToStop() (Marker eventHandlers.click -> scrollToStop). Measured: scrollY 0 -> 764 and the freshly-opened popup ends up at y=-378 (above the viewport/behind the sticky header), so the popup content and its own 'Go to stop' button are unreachable. The scroll-on-click also duplicates the dedicated button. Recommend removing eventHandlers={{click: scrollToStop}} from <Marker> and keeping only the popup button.

issues: transport_mode='other' renders a dashed grey line identical in style to the ORS-failure fallback dash, so a user cannot distinguish 'not applicable' from 'route unavailable' (popup text differs: 'Not calculated'). Minor: consider a distinct style or no line for 'other'.

action_items: Remove the Marker-level click->scrollToStop handler in TripMap.jsx (popup jumps off-screen after opening).
Optional: simplify/limit ORS geometry payload and throttle concurrent ORS calls for long trips.
critical_code_review_comments: map_routes.py fires len(stops)-1 concurrent ORS requests via asyncio.gather on a cold cache — add a semaphore (e.g. 3) to stay under the free-tier rate limit.
Negative ORS results are not cached, so a rate-limited/unroutable pair re-hits ORS (4s timeout) on every page open; consider caching a null-geometry sentinel with a short TTL.
route_cache docs are correctly quantised to 4 decimals and API responses exclude _id (verified) — good.
TripMap.jsx is 455 lines and mixes helpers (arc math, formatters, icon builder) with the component; extracting helpers would help but not blocking.

rca_of_the_issue: Marker popup off-screen: TripMap.jsx <Marker eventHandlers={{click: () => scrollToStop(s.stop_id)}}>. Leaflet opens the bound Popup on the same click, then the smooth scrollIntoView({block:'center'}) moves the stop card into view, translating the map (and its popup) out of the viewport. Repro: open /trip/<id>, dispatch a native click on the 2nd .twt-map-pin -> window.scrollY 0->764, popup boundingRect.y = -378.
